teaches: A skill is a `talent` Item with `system.subType: "skill"` embedded on the Actor. There is no `system.skills` anywhere in this system.
The speciality is stored twice on purpose: in the name, in brackets, and in `skill.speciality`.
`roll.characteristic` is the characteristic the skill is normally rolled on, which the sheet offers as the default.
demo.trap: `level` is 0 here because a loose skill in a compendium is a template — the level belongs to the Traveller who has it. Everything that reads a skill matches by *name*, so `Demo — Gun Combat` matches this Item and a bare `Gun Combat` does not.

system.description: Firing a slug thrower. The speciality is the family of weapon, not the weapon.
